long_biography.plain_text:
Professional guiding gave Kaan İşçil the operating knowledge behind his travel business. He learned how hotels, transport and itineraries could be negotiated and combined before establishing Kappa Tur in the early 2000s. The company began with a small international programme and developed into an outbound operator selling escorted packages, flights, accommodation and related travel services.

Travel Zone extended that model into business-to-business production. İşçil founded the platform, with Barış Öztürk directing operations, to assemble packages for Kappa Tur and other agencies. That structure widened his reach beyond direct consumer sales while keeping supplier negotiation and itinerary design at the centre. He remains Kappa Tur's owner, chairman, general manager and professional guide.
